comment: The shipped predict() raises for any initial side other than 5.00 +/- 0.05, so only side-5.00 runs can be scored as shipped. Scored with the shipped code, all four side-5.00 runs pass the bar 3 x 0.07 = 0.21: 2026-11-19/r3/lab-b/001 (C,C,A) error 0.00488; 2026-11-20/r3/lab-b/001 (A,A,A) 0.00529; 2026-11-20/r3/lab-b/002 (A,B,C) 0.00491; 2026-11-20/r3/lab-b/003 (B,B,C) 0.00488. Claim c1 is replicated at side 5.00 with three or more passing runs. Claim c2 (A-only, sides 3.75 to 5.0) has only one scoreable run (r3/001, side 5.00), so it is not supported beyond side 5.00 by runs the shipped predictor can score. The narrowed domain is therefore r_range 4.95 to 5.05. This replaces my 2026-11-20 review, which cited sides 3.8, 4.2, 4.6 and 5.4 scored with a locally overridden reference separation R0 that is not in the shipped code. I withdraw those runs as evidence. The side-3.8 A,A,A run (2026-11-20/r1/lab-b/006) is a shipped-predictor refusal and is outside the proposed domain. Mid-range side lengths (3.8 to 4.9 and 5.1 to 5.5) remain untested by any run the shipped code can score.
